path.name: overall_verdict
path.PROBLEM: If ANY dimension is KILLED (even without evidence), overall is KILLED. No INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE option for non-boundary, non-prior-art dimensions.

critical_gap.issue: Dimensions MECHANISM_VALIDITY, TRANSFER_LEGITIMACY, OBVIOUSNESS, ENGINEERING_FEASIBILITY, FALSIFIABILITY, REGULATORY_INCOMPATIBILITY have NO INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE state. The LLM can only respond PASS or KILLED. When uncertain, it defaults to KILLED.
critical_gap.impact: 6 of 8 dimensions lack INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE. This is the structural root cause of false kills.
